verdict.rationale: Jitsu supports personal API keys for headless/CI authentication and mentions 'named user API tokens with expiration' plus OAuth-protected MCP server access, suggesting some credential issuance controls, but there is no explicit documentation of scoped/least-privilege permission levels (e.g., read-only vs write, per-resource scopes) for these tokens or agent credentials. missing for 10: explicit scope/permission granularity for API tokens, documentation of least-privilege roles for agent-issued keys, independent confirmation of scoping enforcement.
